content.text: You gain the following benefits.

content.label: Initiative Proficiency
content.text: When you roll [Initiative](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/initiative), you can add your [Proficiency Bonus](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/proficiency) to the roll.

content.label: Initiative Swap
content.text: Immediately after you roll [Initiative](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/initiative), you can swap your [Initiative](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/initiative) with the [Initiative](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/initiative) of one willing ally in the same combat. You can't make this swap if you or the ally has the [Incapacitated](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/incapacitated) condition.
You gain the following benefits.

content.label: Two Cantrips
content.text: You learn two cantrips of your choice from the Cleric, Druid, or Wizard spell list. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this feat's spells (choose when you select this feat).

content.label: Level 1 Spell
content.text: Choose a level 1 spell from the same list you selected for this feat's cantrips. You always have that spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a [Long Rest](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/long-rest). You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have.

content.label: Spell Change
content.text: Whenever you gain a new level, you can replace one of the spells you chose for this feat with a different spell of the same level from the chosen spell list.

content.label: Repeatable
content.text: You can take this feat more than once, but you must choose a different spell list each time.
You've trained to deal particularly damaging strikes. Once per turn when you hit a target with a weapon, you can roll the weapon's damage dice twice and use either roll against the target.
You gain proficiency in any combination of three [skills](srd-5.2/01/proficiency/skill-proficiencies/skill-list) or tools of your choice.

content.label: Punch and Grab
content.text: When you hit a creature with an [Unarmed Strike](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/unarmed-strike) as part of the [Attack](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/attack) action on your turn, you can use both the Damage and the Grapple option. You can use this benefit only once per turn.

content.label: Attack Advantage
content.text: You have [Advantage](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/advantage) on attack rolls against a creature [Grappled](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/grappled) by you.

content.label: Fast Wrestler
content.text: You don't have to spend extra movement to move a creature [Grappled](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/grappled) by you if the creature is your size or smaller.

ability_increase.text: Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

content.text: You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls you make with Ranged weapons.
While you're wearing Light, Medium, or Heavy armor, you gain a +1 bonus to [Armor Class](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/armor-class).

When you roll damage for an attack you make with a Melee weapon that you are holding with two hands, you can treat any 1 or 2 on a damage die as a 3. The weapon must have the [Two-Handed](srd-5.2/06/weapons/properties/two-handed) or [Versatile](srd-5.2/06/weapons/properties/versatile) property to gain this benefit.

When you make an extra attack as a result of using a weapon that has the [Light](srd-5.2/06/weapons/properties/light) property, you can add your ability modifier to the damage of that attack if you aren't already adding it to the damage.
